evals.prompt: Check our README claim that the app automatically resets every device at midnight. The implementation has a client timer, but I have no sleeping-device evidence.
evals.expected_output: Splits the claim into atomic scope, reports partial verification rather than verified, and identifies sleeping-device or wake-reconciliation evidence as missing.

evals.prompt: The release notes say all production browser tests passed. Verify that from this development screenshot.
evals.expected_output: Rejects development screenshot evidence as production and full-suite proof, labels the claim unsupported or needs-human, and requests revision-bound release evidence.

evals.prompt: Fact-check this setup guide and fix every unsupported sentence.
evals.expected_output: Performs the factual assessment first, does not silently rewrite claims, and requires or recognizes separate editing authorization before routing wording changes through writing-quality-editor.
